capability.name: Motor tributario
intents: determinar jurisdiccion y lugar de suministro
resolver tasas y tratamientos fiscales vigentes
aplicar exenciones sustituciones y posiciones fiscales
evaluar retenciones y su momento de causacion
producir legs y tags para contabilidad y reporte fiscal
provisionar o actualizar politica tributaria de un pais

dependencies: product tax classification and attached tax codes
ledger account roles and tax tags

rates formulas thresholds sourcing and report layouts require effective versioned policy
AR AP POS Inventory and Payroll consume tax results but do not implement tax calculation
tax emits semantic legs and account roles but never posts concrete Ledger accounts
missing required jurisdiction nexus behavior or policy fails closed
historical documents retain the policy and behavior versions used at calculation time
tenant and legal entity isolation are mandatory

deterministic: inspect effective tax codes behaviors assignments and substitutions
explain calculation legs and applied policy versions
identify jurisdiction nexus and sourcing inputs
compare a requested rule against published universal primitives
poDecision: accepting a new universal tax primitive
changing product behavior visible to customers
accepting a compatibility break in country pack lifecycle
architectHandoff: country pack publication or migration design
tax to Ledger posting contract change

no new country literal in core calculation logic
effective dating and historical behavior pinning
tenant legal entity and jurisdiction isolation
